instruction: Using the web extension tool, set up a new extension project called "tab-manager v2.1.5". Leave the description field blank. Add a background script and browser action to the extension. Unzip the generated package into "~/Projects".

metadata.explanation: Task requires using webext.eu to create an extension with name 'tab-manager' and version '2.1.5'. The evaluator verifies the manifest.json contains correct name, version, background scripts, and browser_action configuration. State-based evaluation checking manifest structure.
